design: Three task families, prose and structured formats; sixteen items each, both value assignments, both fact orders, both queried entities. All contexts contain two distinct values. Exact answer label follows entity/value assignment. Single-token source values and answers, query-pair position/length alignment; complete eight-cell item gate.
gate_scope: Each task/format independently; require candidate>=.75 separately for query to first and second displayed fact. No correctness-based item removal.
future_contrast: Compare query-to-first vs query-to-second at identical preceding facts; fixed first-value logprob and first-vs-second margin are primary response readouts, correctness secondary. Local source state is naturally query-invariant; do not duplicate it as an independent cross.
limitation: Distinct from repeated identical-value copying, but still short two-fact retrieval; no general manifold inference.
